dimensions.obligation_correctness: Recover admission, retained audit, monotonic UI, reentrant cleanup priority, and inherited retry ownership.
dimensions.evidence_grounding: Cite the candidate README and the progress, transfer, queue, panel, and retry modules.
dimensions.failure_prediction: Predict missed warm frames, post-retirement admission, UI rollback, audit loss, superseded destination startup, or owner theft.
dimensions.unsupported_claim_penalty: Do not merge audit and UI lifetimes or infer freshness from decode completion order.

obligations.statement: Install the attempt listener before start can emit its warm frame.
Only a current, non-aborted attempt may admit a new frame; already accepted decode still completes.
obligations.event_relation: Attempt validity is checked before decode begins.
obligations.failure_if_violated: Retired work is newly accepted or accepted history is canceled.

obligations.statement: Within a visit, arrival order across retry attempts controls visible full-frame freshness even when decode completion reverses.
obligations.event_relation: Visit-owned arrival token precedes decode; visible commit compares that token.
obligations.failure_if_violated: An older frame or old-attempt completion rolls the UI backward.

obligations.statement: Every accepted frame is audited once, while UI additionally requires current visit and freshness.
obligations.event_relation: Audit completion is unconditional for accepted work; UI uses narrower guards.
obligations.failure_if_violated: Retired audit disappears or stale UI appears.

obligations.statement: A navigation begun during listener removal supersedes the older outer navigation before its destination starts.
obligations.event_relation: Retire current owner, invoke cleanup, then revalidate the outer request.
obligations.failure_if_violated: B starts after cleanup already selected C or hid the panel.
required_concepts: cleanup is a synchronous reentrant boundary

obligations.statement: Retry still cancels before enqueue, retains the accepted command, and cannot steal a newer owner.
obligations.event_relation: Old cancellation precedes one new attempt while visit checks govern ownership and notice.
obligations.failure_if_violated: Duplicate active transfers, lost record, stale notice, or owner theft.
required_concepts: accepted command differs from current ownership

obligations.statement: Queue record fields stay unchanged unless byteCount is separately authorized.
The panel must receive cached bootstrap without changing the adjacent diagnostic consumer's live-delta-only policy.
obligations.event_relation: Consumer policy determines whether listener installation precedes or follows start.
obligations.failure_if_violated: Telemetry counts cached panel state as a live delta.
required_concepts: shared API does not imply shared consumer policy
